name: Center/scale only (looks already log/normalized)
reason: Values look already log-transformed or normalized — do NOT log again.
assumptions: Data are already on a comparable scale.

name: Internal-standard normalization (if you have IS features/columns)
reason: Normalize each sample to spiked internal-standard features (you select them).
assumptions: Internal standards are stable across samples.
warnings: Requires you to identify the internal-standard features/columns.

name: Quantile normalization (forces identical distributions)
reason: Aggressively removes distribution differences between samples.
assumptions: Global distribution shifts are technical, not biological.
warnings: Inappropriate when distribution shifts are biologically real.
